body: Until w-184d1c27edea lands (Fable2 #5572, 2026-11-11): when dispatching a registered (Central, --input commit) focused batch that will feed an acceptance evaluation, put fmt, clippy/lint and other unclassified checks BEFORE the final recognized test step. A passed run with only unclassified stages (e.g. cargo fmt --check) as the newest terminal run on the commit makes termal_evaluate_acceptance refuse 409 verification_record_unclassified_stages before spawn. Workaround if it happens: one recognized cargo test run on the same commit, then evaluate. Seen on 11334 w-33a1 0fa7b372 (run test-09164d5b).
